description: This file is a PHP script that initializes a console application for the OrangeHRM project. It sets up dependencies, includes necessary classes, and adds several command objects to the console application, facilitating tasks like database setup, role management, and code standard fixing.

classes.description: Symfony Console Application class used to manage and execute command-line commands.

classes.description: Command to fix coding standards issues in PHP code.

classes.description: Command to reset the system installation.
